title: TITAN
paper_title: A Multimodal Whole-Slide Foundation Model for Pathology
core_mech: TITAN 的特异性是三阶段 whole-slide 预训练：特征网格 iBOT、ROI caption CoCa、WSI report CoCa。
core_mech_en: Three-stage multimodal whole-slide foundation model pretrained via iBOT on 2D tile feature grids, CoCa on synthetic ROI captions, and CoCa on whole-slide pathology reports.
input_desc: 预提取病理 patch 网格、ROI 合成描述和 WSI 病理报告
input_en: Pre-extracted 2D spatial grid of WSI patch embeddings (CONCH v1.5) + ROI descriptions / clinical pathology reports
output_desc: 通用 whole-slide embedding、跨模态检索分数与病理文本生成
output_en: General-purpose whole-slide embedding, zero-shot slide classification, cross-modal report retrieval, and slide report generation
